shared/home-intro.html.code:
Hello, Everyone

I’m a product designer and design lead. I turn complex workflows and business requirements into clear, usable B2B and B2C products, from early discovery through launch and ongoing improvement.

I enjoy the stage when the problem is still taking shape: making sense of complexity and helping a team find a clear direction. My work combines hands-on design, research, and team leadership, with close attention to the small details people encounter every day.

shared/about-main.html.code:
I’m Dima, a designer with a background in banking, classifieds, and marketplaces. I’ve worked with companies and brands including Yandex, Raiffeisen Bank, Decathlon, and Leroy Merlin, as well as small teams and startups. My projects span Russia, Cyprus, and the US.

I like making complex products easier to use. There’s often a lot of thought and teamwork behind something that looks simple. I stay hands-on while shaping how design teams work.

How I work

To clarify our goals and explore how to reach them, I discuss ideas with stakeholders, review data, and talk to users. I care about how an interface works, looks, and feels — and its impact on the business.

Having built websites myself, I’m comfortable reading code and discussing technical decisions with engineers. I also build workflows with AI agents to support design and research.

I help designers see their strengths and decide where to grow. Competency frameworks and individual development plans help us agree on next steps.

Outside of work

In my triathlon days, I ran several marathons, completed a half Ironman, and logged thousands of kilometers on Zwift. I also started a local running club.

I enjoy skiing and cycling. When I want some time to myself, I head out on my paddleboard — I love the quiet out on the water.

dependencies.note: Local Lora Italic 400, lossless WOFF conversion. OFL license: /assets/lora-license.txt. Load only on pages rendering recommendations.

notes: shared/tokens.css, shared/site-ui.css and the generated shared/theme-dark.css rules compile together into /assets/site-ui.css; load the generated stylesheet once.

The timer is 12 seconds of visible, unpaused time. An active 60 × 12 px rounded rectangle fills, shrinks to a circle on change, and the next starts from zero. Manual selection restarts the timer. Lora quote text uses the named --type-quote:22px token on desktop and mobile (unitless1.5leading;33px computed line height). Name uses 18px Manrope through --type-body; role and company use 16px Manrope through --type-small. The existing unitless 1.8 leading is retained (32.4px for the name and 28.8px for the role/company); heading retains its existing 18px size. Dmitry Rybalka

Work, life & more

I’m Dima, a designer with a background in banking, classifieds, and marketplaces. I’ve worked with companies and brands including Yandex, Raiffeisen Bank, Decathlon, and Leroy Merlin, as well as small teams and startups. My projects span Russia, Cyprus, and the US.

I like making complex products easier to use. There’s often a lot of thought and teamwork behind something that looks simple. I stay hands-on while shaping how design teams work.

What people say

How I work

To clarify our goals and explore how to reach them, I discuss ideas with stakeholders, review data, and talk to users. I care about how an interface works, looks, and feels — and its impact on the business.

Having built websites myself, I’m comfortable reading code and discussing technical decisions with engineers. I also build workflows with AI agents to support design and research.

I help designers see their strengths and decide where to grow. Competency frameworks and individual development plans help us agree on next steps.

Outside of work

In my triathlon days, I ran several marathons, completed a half Ironman, and logged thousands of kilometers on Zwift. I also started a local running club.

I enjoy skiing and cycling. When I want some time to myself, I head out on my paddleboard — I love the quiet out on the water.

in mind? Drop me a message — or just say hello!

Homepage layout, portrait and project cards

notes: This is the current custom status dot, not a Lucide icon. Pulse behavior belongs to the availability component in its visible work context.

favicon.html:
<link rel="icon" href="/assets/favicon.ico?v=f48a5dcf6c33" sizes="16x16 32x32 48x48">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/assets/favicon-32.png?v=418c2f22aafd" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="/assets/favicon-16.png?v=a50154754ffd" sizes="16x16">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/assets/apple-touch-icon.png?v=94a2efca3e42" sizes="180x180">
<link rel="manifest" href="/assets/site.webmanifest?v=068621bc9238">
notes: Place these links inside the document head. Root-relative URLs work on nested project pages too.
These are the current homepage favicon links. About and 404 use the same ICO and Apple touch icon; DS uses the ICO.
The manifest resolves its 192px and 512px icon URLs relative to /assets/. Preserve that location when reusing the exact file.
All previews use the existing frontal portrait files. Light and dark backgrounds show the same asset, without recoloring.
